Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Dharmendra Kumar Trivedi, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Anshuman
Vema, the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
199/2021, under Sections 363, 366, 376 Ipc & Section 5/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual
Offences Act, 2012, Police Station Nasirabad, District Raebareli.

sentences.text:
3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 15.08.2021 against the applicant and Ram Charan, stating that the applicant had enticed away the informant's daughter aged 15 years on 14.08.2021 and she had taken away some cash and jewelry with her.
4.

In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she stated that the applicant had enticed her away and had kept her at the house of his sister but she had not taken away Pankaj vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. ... on 29 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19610394/
1 anything with her.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. The victim declined to undergo medico legal examination.
6. As per the radio-logical examination report, the age of the victim has been opined between 16 to 17 years.
7. In the additional statement of the victim, she alleged that the applicant had committed the misdeed against her in the house of his sister.

8. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she reiterated her version in her additional statement and she stated that she knows the applicant for the past 5 months, the applicant has not assured to marry her and now she wants to live with her family members.

9. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is a young man aged 22 years having no criminal history and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
10. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail application and he has submitted that the information of the present application has been delivered to the informant through police.
He has further submitted that the allegations have been established during investigation and a charge-sheet has been submitted on 12.12.2021.

11. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the victim has admitted that she was in a relationship with the applicant for the past 5 months;
that the victim has declined to undergo medico legal examination and the victim has not supported the prosecution case in her cross examination, coupled with the fact that the applicant is a young man aged 22 years having no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 16.10.2024 whereas the investigation already stands concluded, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
12. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

13. Let the applicant-Pankaj be released on bail in the aforementioned case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned,
subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial Court.
Order Date :- 29.5.2025 Pradeep/-
